title: Local file provisioning uses the same Repository CRD as Git Sync
answers: How do I provision a local file system / dashboards as code (not via UI)?
What's the YAML schema for local/file provisioning?
Why is there no `type: file` in the Repository resource?
How does the UI's 'file provisioning / local storage' map to the Repository CRD?
body: Local file provisioning is not a separate CRD — it's the same `provisioning.grafana.app/v0alpha1` `Repository` resource used by Git Sync, with `spec.type: local` and `spec.local.path` set to a directory on the Grafana server's filesystem. The path must fall under a `permitted_provisioning_paths` entry in grafana.ini/custom.ini. Shared fields `spec.sync` (enabled/intervalSeconds/target) and `spec.workflows` behave identically to Git Sync repos. Push/manage it with `gcx resources push|get|edit|delete repository/<name>`, same as any other Repository.
applies: Any work on Grafana's as-code provisioning (Repository resource, gcx resources commands, or Git Sync / local storage docs/code).
